title: Antiseptic

inlines.v: ANTISEP'TIC, adjective [Gr. putrid, from to putrify.] Opposing or counteracting putrefaction. ANTISEP'TIC, noun A medicine which resists or corrects putrefaction, as acids, stimulants, saline substances, astringents, etc.
